t: Section 101 of the Government Corporation Control Act is amended by striking out. “Federal Public Housing Authority (or Public Housing Administration)” and inserting in lieu thereof “United States Housing Authority”.

fable.w: This section is a purely technical amendment that substitutes one federal agency's name for another in the Government Corporation Control Act. The word "Public" in the agency names might look on-topic, but it is only part of a proper noun; no party outside the federal government is consulted, heard, or given a right to sue over any federal decision.
fable.s: striking out. “Federal Public Housing Authority (or Public Housing Administration)” and inserting in lieu thereof “United States Housing Authority”

qwen_block.w: This section is a purely technical amendment changing the name of a federal agency within a statute. It does not establish any process for consultation, coordination, or input from outside parties (such as the public, states, or private entities) regarding a federal decision. It involves no advisory boards, public hearings, or rights to sue.
qwen_block.s: Section 101 of the Government Corporation Control Act is amended by striking out. “Federal Public Housing Authority (or Public Housing Administration)” and inserting in lieu thereof “United States Housing Authority”.
